48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.38.7 - SAVE TO USUAL POINTS
  - Meetings… → Prayer groups → 1 Prayer points: "Save to usual points", next to "Use the usual points". The points with their
    items (and which go together, and the number of groups) become the usual ones of this kind of meeting; this meeting's
    groups are not touched. They go to the phones at once when this computer is signed in to the portal.
  - "Publish to the portal" does the same and also gives this meeting's groups the new points.
